architecture: Chronos-2 120M plus rank-8 LoRA domain adapter

contract.short_context_policy: left pad to 365 with the earliest observed value
contract.missing_history_policy: linear interpolation within observed history only

calibration.scale: mean absolute first difference over the latest 90 context days

fresh_transfer_audit.dataset: UCI Power Consumption of Tetouan City

conservative_baseline_check.policy: Post-gate robustness check against the strongest of every declared causal seasonal comparator; it cannot affect model selection or loosen promotion.

morocco_held_out_zones.warning: This diagnostic failed point-accuracy gates; monitor and recalibrate for these southern Morocco meter types.

performance.note: Cold load includes resolving the locally cached pinned Chronos-2 base model.

limitations: The public research datasets contain aggregate/client load rather than the target application's exact live-meter population.

Tetouan was never used by this project's training, selection, blending, calibration, or refit stages, but upstream Chronos-2 pretraining exposure to every public series cannot be independently excluded.
The model forecasts daily values; it is not an hourly 720-step endpoint.
Future realized weather is not consumed, preventing weather leakage but limiting response to unpredictable 30-day weather anomalies.
Southern Morocco held-out-zone point accuracy did not beat its seasonal baseline; that population requires monitored rollout or local recalibration.
The base Chronos-2 weights are resolved separately from the pinned upstream revision and are not redistributed in this repository.
